question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：美国 vs 巴拉圭，90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: United States vs Paraguay — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 实力极为接近的均势开局：巴拉圭 Elo 更高但核心恩西索伤疑，美国坐拥东道主主场之利，胜负接近五五开、平局风险不低。
one_liner_en: A near coin-flip opener: Paraguay carry the higher Elo but creator Enciso is doubtful, while the USA enjoy true host-nation advantage; draw risk is substantial.

key_reasons.cn: 巴拉圭头号进攻核心恩西索 6 月 5 日热身赛受伤被担架抬下，MRI 排除结构性撕裂但首战出战成疑。
key_reasons.en: Paraguay's primary creator Julio Enciso was stretchered off in the June 5 friendly; an MRI ruled out a structural tear but he is highly doubtful for the opener.

key_reasons.cn: 美国主力中卫 Richards 踝部韧带伤后 6 月 8 日才恢复合练，预计无法首发，削弱美国防线。
key_reasons.en: USA starting CB Chris Richards only resumed full training June 8 after tearing two ankle ligaments and is unlikely to start, weakening the US back line.

key_reasons.cn: 比赛在加州 SoFi Stadium 进行，美国作为东道主获得真实主场优势，模型 +100 主场分使两队修正后实力几乎持平（Elo 1726+100 vs 1834）。
key_reasons.en: Played at SoFi Stadium in California, the USA get genuine host advantage; the model's +100 host bonus leaves adjusted strength almost even (Elo 1726+100 vs 1834).

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, +100 host bonus for USA group matches) gives p_stat USA 36.2/draw 25.9/PAR 37.9; bounded evidence adjustment of +1.5pp USA / -1.5pp PAR (Enciso loss outweighs Richards loss). No betting or prediction-market inputs used.
